works.form: Book (Book I published 2017; Book II, the redux, in progress)
works.status: Book I: 'How to Survive 45', subtitled 'Remembering You're Extraordinary', published on KDP in 2017. Book II: 'Remembering You're Extraordinary', the redux, in progress, a substantially reimagined successor growing from the ideas and principles of Book I, in active development in Santa's Workshop. It is the only Remembering You're Extraordinary book in progress (clarified by Robert, 2026-11-19). The Rye House is the book's literary home. The original is retained in the Library and Publishing Office; publishing history includes a Broadleaf Books submission in April 2026. Corrected by Robert 2026-11-18: Book I's title is How to Survive 45, with Remembering You're Extraordinary as its subtitle; earlier wording that titled the original itself Remembering You're Extraordinary, and called RYE 2.0 a version 2 of it, is superseded.
